title: Chopping up books when they're physically too big
summary: A practical guide on physically cutting apart oversized or unwieldy books to make them more manageable, portable, and usable. The author shares their experience and techniques for dismantling large books that would otherwise be impractical to handle or store.
problem_solved: Solves the problem of physically large books that are impractical to use, store, or travel with.
why_valuable: Provides a creative, unconventional solution for book lovers who want to preserve and actually use oversized volumes that would otherwise sit unused due to their impractical dimensions.
